# IntelliHRTrack

> IntelliHRTrack is a web-based employee management, biometric attendance, and payroll system developed for the Department of Agriculture MIMAROPA Region in the Philippines, as a capstone project at Mindoro State University, Calapan Campus.

## Team

- Renzo Jacob C. Tamayo, project leader
- Glayzel Ann O. Soriano, team member
- Angel Kris M. Ronquillo, team member
- Fidel C. Romasanta, capstone adviser

All from Mindoro State University, Calapan Campus, Oriental Mindoro, Philippines.

## What it does

- Records attendance from Hikvision face and fingerprint terminals and matches each scan to an employee.
- Builds each employee's daily time record (Civil Service Form No. 48) from those scans.
- Computes worked hours, late arrivals, and undertime against assigned schedules.
- Handles leave requests and approvals, official travel, holidays, and work suspensions.
- Computes payroll for Job Order (JO), Contract of Service (COS), and Permanent employees, and produces payslips and payroll registers.
- Limits access by branch: administrators manage their own office, and employees see only their own records.

## Pages

- [Home](https://intellihrtrack-mimaropa.up.railway.app/): overview of the system. All other pages require an approved account.
